digest.component_or_area: Live DC Harness & Rich-Text Cutover Integration
propositions: Live DC harness test renders pushed rich-text body to HTML via ?expand=renderedFields and asserts wiki markup converts correctly (Markdown heading/bold to h1/b tags, {code} macro to pre block)

Second reconcile pass after pushed body converges with zero inbound description mutations, proving state-based echo-safety when inbound differ treats Jira's landed wire form as unchanged via map_fields_to_remote
Both-sides concurrent edit (rebar-side and Jira-side description changes to same baseline) results in local-wins emit and deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert with remote value recorded
Contract test pins InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text signature and behavior (None→'', plain str→identity, ADF dict→adf_to_text) so breaking changes fail cross-repo imports
Inbound differ now mirrors outbound echo-suppression by injecting OutboundMapper port and comparing Jira value against landed wire form, closing codec-aware echo gap in DC rich-text path
